```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Next-delivery toggle.
#
# Reads the `delivery` block from _variables.yml (the single file that the
# organiser edits) and, when delivery.active is "true", emits a styled callout
# with the details of the next delivery. When it is "false" – the evergreen default
# – this chunk emits nothing, so the page reads as an undated, standing
# workshop. Activation is therefore a one-line edit in _variables.yml and needs
# no change to any page. A delivery that names one of the tracks in
# delivery.track also gets a line linking the page of that track.
#
# Base R only, and no dependency beyond yaml. The page that includes this chunk,
# index.qmd, is the only one rendered with freeze: false, so the chunk executes in
# CI, where the workflow installs knitr, rmarkdown and yaml and nothing else.

find_variables_file <- function() {
  candidates <- c("_variables.yml", "../_variables.yml", "../../_variables.yml")
  hits <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hits)) hits[[1]] else NA_character_
}

vars_path <- find_variables_file()

if (!is.na(vars_path) && requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  vars <- yaml::read_yaml(vars_path)
  delivery <- vars[["delivery"]]

  # Accept either a quoted string ('true') or a bare YAML boolean (true).
  is_active <- !is.null(delivery) &&
    tolower(as.character(delivery[["active"]])) == "true"

  if (is_active) {
    field <- function(x) {
      if (is.null(x)) return(NA_character_)
      x <- as.character(x)
      if (!nzchar(x)) NA_character_ else x
    }
    present <- function(...) {
      vals <- c(...)
      vals[!is.na(vals)]
    }

    # The tracks, keyed by the slug that names the folder of each under
    # tracks/ (<slug>-<format>). A slug that the EU-frames tracks had before
    # they carried the case is read as the slug that replaced it, except
    # "semester", which names the cross-case semester track and is listed only
    # once tracks/semester/ exists. Anything else in delivery.track – a typo,
    # a retired name, an empty string – matches nothing here, so no line is
    # printed and no link is written to a page that does not exist. The link
    # is relative to the including page, and index.qmd at the site root is the
    # only one; an include from a subdirectory would need a ../ in front of
    # tracks/.
    track_labels <- c(
      "housing-short"                 = "short session on the housing-audit case",
      "housing-one-day"               = "one-day course on the housing-audit case",
      "eu-frames-one-day-replication" = "one-day course on the EU-frames case, open science and replication",
      "eu-frames-one-day-tools"       = "one-day course on the EU-frames case, social data science tools",
      "eu-frames-one-day-methods"     = "one-day course on the EU-frames case, the statistical methods",
      "eu-frames-three-days"          = "three-day format of the EU-frames case",
      "eu-frames-semester"            = "semester format of the EU-frames case",
      "eu-frames-self-study"          = "self-study track of the EU-frames case"
    )
    if (dir.exists("tracks/semester")) {
      track_labels <- c(track_labels, "semester" = "semester track across the four cases")
    }
    former_slugs <- c("one-day-replication", "one-day-tools", "one-day-methods",
                      "three-days", "self-study")

    date <- field(delivery[["date"]])
    venue <- field(delivery[["venue"]])
    event <- field(delivery[["event"]])
    mode <- field(delivery[["mode"]])
    reg_url <- field(delivery[["registration_url"]])
    note <- field(delivery[["note"]])
    track <- tolower(trimws(field(delivery[["track"]])))
    if (track %in% former_slugs) track <- paste0("eu-frames-", track)

    out <- c("", '::: {.callout-tip title="Next delivery" appearance="default"}')

    when_where <- paste(present(date, venue), collapse = " – ")
    if (nzchar(when_where)) out <- c(out, "", paste0("**", when_where, "**"))
    if (!is.na(event)) out <- c(out, "", paste0("Event: ", event))
    if (!is.na(mode)) out <- c(out, "", paste0("Mode: ", mode))
    if (!is.na(note)) out <- c(out, "", note)
    if (track %in% names(track_labels)) {
      out <- c(out, "", paste0(
        "This delivery follows the [", track_labels[[track]],
        "](tracks/", track, "/index.qmd)."
      ))
    }
    if (!is.na(reg_url)) {
      out <- c(out, "", paste0("[Register or express interest](", reg_url, ")"))
    }
    out <- c(out, "", ":::", "")

    cat(paste(out, collapse = "\n"))  # r-style: keep – an asis chunk writes its Markdown through cat()
  }
}
```
